resumen: The mid-boss for the other party, and according to the guides the hardest in the raid: spirits, orbs to catch, coloured orbs you face or turn away from, and a final phase with soul stones where often only the Cleric survives. We have almost no logs of him: the player who records in our group usually does Rahu.

mecanicas.texto: Ketu sweeps the arena with lasers and dashes at a marked player with a heavy weapon strike; where the weapon lands, a wave goes out.
mecanicas.como: Dodge the lasers; against the charge, step out of the strike and jump the wave it leaves.

mecanicas.texto: Ketu goes to the centre and can no longer be attacked; spirits spawn around the arena. Then a white zone advances, and a living spirit that touches it explodes and fears the whole group. At the end there is a safe zone in the centre, but it does not stop all the damage.
mecanicas.como: The group splits into two sides and kills the spirits from south to north, each side in one direction; ranged classes help a lot. When the white zone closes, everyone to the centre, and keep healing inside it.

mecanicas.texto: Orbs fall from the sky and have to be caught before they touch the ground.
mecanicas.como: One per person, jumping to get there sooner. It pays to count how many fall on the first attempt: guides count those of the 8-player version.

mecanicas.titulo: Coloured orbs: face or turn away
mecanicas.texto: From half health, orbs appear that explode, and what counts is where your character faces (not the camera). One at first; later, three in a row.
mecanicas.como: Red orb: face it. Blue orb: turn your back to it. Beware of guides that have it the other way round.

mecanicas.texto: Everyone gets a red cone and soul stones appear at the edge of the arena; a cone destroys any stone it touches. Breaking a stone gives that player a few seconds of invulnerability, and right after Ketu hits the whole arena again and again.
mecanicas.como: As intended: each player breaks their stone just before the hit and refreshes it. As usually done: the Cleric survives on their stone and resurrects the group, so their survival is the priority.

todos.texto: The Ketu party needs a Cleric who can resurrect, and a Ranger helps with the spirits.

sanador.texto: At the soul stones, if the Cleric survives, Ketu still dies even if everyone else falls: save resurrections and defensives for that phase.

notas.texto: Guide mechanics are from the previous version (Korea and Early Access). NCSOFT changed mechanics for the 4 November return and there are no guides to the new one yet: everything about Ketu is "not seen".
We only have 3 attempts on Ketu, from one night and without a kill, and no public raid: not enough figures to check anything.
